info.title: Open Streamer API
info.description: The REST API of Open Streamer: the streams, the assets (watermark images and fonts), the config editor, the reload and the status documents. Every route but /healthz needs HTTP Basic credentials of a user in the config file; a viewer reads, an editor reads and writes (x-role on each operation). A viewer's ?secrets=1 is 403 on every authenticated route, not only on the stream routes. Every response has Cache-Control: no-store (the thumbnail and an asset's file: no-cache) and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. A request no route answers gets a plain-text 404 or 405, without authentication. The editor also has net/http/pprof under /debug/pprof/. The API has no TLS before M5c: keep it on loopback or behind a TLS reverse proxy. Run the server under a service manager that restarts it: there is no per-stream panic recovery, so a panic ends the process and the restart restores every stream from the config file.

get.summary: Every stream's document, sorted by name.

put.description: The edit is written to the config file and applied: only what differs is touched. The whole resulting config is judged.

requestBody.description: The stream's document, at most 1048576 bytes; unknown fields are refused.

200.description: The stream was replaced, or nothing differed.
The JPEG. Cache-Control is no-cache; the ETag is "<epoch>-<pts>".

assets.description: The assets, sorted by name. A file that is not a regular file, has no asset name, or is over its kind's limit is not listed.

200.description: The bytes, streamed. Content-Type is the asset's type, Content-Disposition is attachment, Cache-Control is no-cache; Range requests are served.

put.description: The body is checked (an image must decode as the format its name says, a font must be a single sfnt face that the font probe accepts) and stored whole: a reader sees the old bytes or the new ones. Every stream with a supervisor that names the asset is given the new bytes, and every stream left stopped that names it is tried again. At most 2 uploads run at once: an upload waits up to 30 s for a slot. Once it has one, its body must arrive within 30 s plus 1 s per 256 KiB of its kind's limit (34 s for an image, 126 s for a font).

requestBody.description: The file's bytes: at most 1048576 for an image, 25165824 for a font. A larger Content-Length is refused before the body is read.

delete.description: Refused while a stream names the asset (asset_in_use) or while the config holds entries the start skipped (config_invalid_entries).

200.description: The YAML text as last loaded, reloaded or written. It holds stream keys and password hashes.

requestBody.description: The YAML text, at most 4194304 bytes; the bytes are written as sent.

200.description: The config was written as sent and applied.

get.summary: The state of the config and of the file.

post.summary: Reload the config file, as SIGHUP does.

200.description: The file was read and applied.
The metrics, in the text format 0.0.4.

name.name: name
name.description: The stream's name. A name no stream can have is a 404.

secrets.name: secrets
secrets.description: With the query exactly ?secrets=1, from an editor, stream URLs are not redacted. A viewer gets 403. Any other query redacts.

ifMatchOptional.name: If-Match
ifMatchOptional.description: One tag, exactly as an ETag header gave it, or *: the write is refused with 412 when the stream has another tag, and also when the stream does not exist (a DELETE of a missing name with If-Match is 412, not 404). A list of tags and a weak tag (W/) never match.

ifMatchRequired.name: If-Match
ifMatchRequired.description: The config's ETag, one tag exactly as GET /api/v1/config returned it; 428 without it, 412 when the config has another. A list of tags, a weak tag (W/) and * never match.

requestedBy.name: X-Requested-By
requestedBy.description: Any non-empty value. Every PUT, DELETE and POST needs it: a cross-site form cannot set it. Checked before the credentials.

assetName.name: name
assetName.description: The asset's name: an image (.png, .jpg, .jpeg) or a font (.ttf, .otf), lower case. A name no asset can have is a 404, and the server is not asked.

assetIfMatch.name: If-Match
assetIfMatch.description: One tag, exactly as an ETag header gave it, or *: the write is refused with 412 when the asset has another tag, and also when it does not exist. The header is compared as one exact strong tag, so a list of tags or a weak tag (W/"…") answers 412, even when it names the asset's tag. The tag is cached by the file's identity, size and modification time: a file edited in place by hand, at the same size within one tick of the file system's clock, can keep its old tag, and a write with that tag is then accepted (hand edits are outside the API's contract).

ifNoneMatchStar.name: If-None-Match
ifNoneMatchStar.description: Only *: the upload is refused with 412 when the asset exists. Any other value is a 400.

ETag.description: The entity tag of the document, for If-Match and If-None-Match. A stream's tag is keyed per process: it changes when the server restarts.

BadRequest.description: bad_request: a body that is not one document of the expected shape or could not be read, a name other than the path's, an asset upload's If-None-Match other than *, or a write without X-Requested-By.

Unauthorized.description: unauthorized: no, malformed or wrong credentials.

Forbidden.description: forbidden: a viewer on an editor's route, or with ?secrets=1.

NotFound.description: not_found: no such stream or asset, an invalid name in the path, or no thumbnail yet.

Conflict.description: conflict: a listen address or a copy:// cycle conflicts with another stream or the server (errors lists each). config_changed: the config file was edited by hand; reload first. config_unreadable (a reload only): the config file cannot be read, or on Unix is not mode 0600; message says why, and nothing changed. assets_off (the asset routes): server.assets_dir is not set. asset_in_use (an asset DELETE): streams name the asset; errors lists them. config_invalid_entries (an asset DELETE): the config holds entries the start skipped, which could name the asset; fix or remove them first.

PreconditionFailed.description: precondition_failed: the If-Match header does not match; for an asset upload, also If-None-Match: * on an asset that exists.

TooLarge.description: too_large: the body is over the limit (an asset: 1048576 bytes for an image, 25165824 for a font).

UnsupportedMediaType.description: unsupported_media_type: the Content-Type is not the one the route takes.

Unprocessable.description: invalid_config: the config that would result is invalid. invalid_spec: the stream cannot run on this server (for one, it turns on rtmp, rtsp or srt while that server.*.listen is empty); it takes precedence over conflict. errors lists every one. invalid_asset (an asset upload): the bytes are not what the name says; message says why.

InsufficientStorage.description: assets_full: the assets directory would hold more than 256 files or 536870912 bytes.

PreconditionRequired.description: precondition_required: the If-Match header is required.

TooManyAttempts.description: too_many_attempts: this address and user name are in a backoff after failed logins, or have 5 logins counted or in flight, or this address has 4 logins being verified, whatever their user names. No address is blocked for failed logins. The address is the connection's: behind a reverse proxy every client shares the proxy's address and so the per-name limits and the one cap of 4.

Internal.description: config_write_failed (a write only): the edit was valid but the config file could not be written (a read-only directory, a full disk); message says why, and nothing was applied. asset_write_failed (an asset write): the asset could not be written or removed; the cause is in the server's log. internal: anything else; the cause is in the server's log.

Unavailable.description: unavailable: the server is stopping, too many logins are waiting (then with Retry-After: 1), an asset upload waited 30 s for one of the 2 upload slots (then with Retry-After: 1), or the request was cancelled. probe_failed (a font upload): the font could not be checked; try again.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait, when logins are waiting.

name.description: The stream's name; in a PUT body it may be empty and must otherwise equal the path's. Not a Windows device name.

disabled.description: The stream is kept in the config and does not run.

inputs.description: The sources by priority, first highest.

layout.description: The track kinds to carry; empty means both.

audio_language.description: BCP 47 tag of the stream's audio, written to the HLS masters and the MPD; empty: not declared.

transcode.description: The ladder; absent for a passthrough stream.

thumbnail.description: The operator preview of the source; absent for none.

outputs.description: The outputs the stream is served on, and where it is pushed.

url.description: The ingest URL. Its password, secret query values and RTMP stream key are masked in responses unless an editor asks with ?secrets=1; a masked URL is refused when written back.

renditions.description: The rungs, each served as <name>_<label>; labels are distinct.

watermark.description: A text or an image drawn on every encoded rung.

Rendition.description: One rung of a ladder: a copy of the source, or an encode.

label.description: The rung's label, distinct within the ladder.

copy.description: The rung is the source, not encoded; a copy rung sets nothing but its label.

height.description: The encoded height in pixels, even.

max_bitrate_kbps.description: The peak video bitrate in kbit/s; 0 means the encoder's default.

b_frames.description: The number of B-frames; 0 means none.

preset.description: The encoder's preset; empty means its default.

encoder.description: The encoder; empty means the server's choice.

no_fallback.description: Fail the ladder when NVENC cannot be opened for this rendition, instead of encoding it with libx264; needs encoder nvenc.

Audio.description: The audio of every rung of a ladder.

copy.description: The source's audio is carried as it is.

bitrate_kbps.description: The AAC bitrate in kbit/s; 0 means the default.

sample_rate.description: The sample rate in Hz; 0 means the source's.

channels.description: The channel count; 0 means the source's.

Watermark.description: A text or an image drawn on every encoded rung; exactly one of text and image is set.

image.description: The name of a PNG or JPEG file in the assets directory.

position.description: The corner, or c for the centre; empty means tl.

opacity_pct.description: The opacity in percent; 0 means the default.

size_pct.description: The size in percent of the picture's height; 0 means the default.

time_zone.description: An IANA time zone for a clock in the text; empty means none.

font.description: The name of a TTF or OTF file in the assets directory, for a text watermark; the built-in DejaVu Sans when empty.

Thumbnail.description: The operator preview of the source.

interval_sec.description: The seconds between shots; 0 means the default.

height.description: The shot's height in pixels; 0 means the default.

quality.description: The JPEG quality; 0 means the default.

Outputs.description: The outputs a stream is served on, and where it is pushed.

push.description: The targets the stream is pushed to; URLs are distinct.

Push.description: One target the stream is pushed to.

url.description: The target URL; masked in responses like an input URL.

generation.description: The number of the running generation; it grows with every rebuild.

since.description: When the generation started; null between generations.

last_error.description: The last error, with URLs redacted; prefixed with the part it came from.

served.description: The names the stream is served under.

outputs.description: The outputs that are on, push URLs redacted.

active_input.description: The index of the input in use; -1 when none.

input_switches.description: How often the active input changed.

tracks.description: The live tracks of the source.

transcoder.description: The transcoder or thumbnailer, when the stream has one.

StatusTrack.description: One live track of the source.

StatusTranscoder.description: The state of a stream's transcoder or thumbnailer.

pid.description: The process ID of the child; 0 while none runs.

spawns.description: How often the child was started.

encoder_fallbacks.description: How often an encoder fell back to another.

encoder_refusals.description: Transcoder children that ended because a no_fallback rendition could not open its encoder.

id.description: The first 8 hex digits of a keyed tag of the URL, which changes when the server restarts: the target label of the metrics.

Outcome.description: What an edit did to one stream.

applied.description: created: a new stream. started: it was disabled or stopped and now runs; also a stream that did not differ but had been left stopped because it could not run (a listen address in use, a missing asset), which every edit and reload tries again. stopped: the stream has no supervisor after the edit (it is disabled). unchanged: nothing differed; a stream left stopped that still cannot run stays so, with its last_error refreshed. outputs: only the outputs differed, applied in place. live: the inputs, the watermark or the audio language of a running stream were changed in place; no session ended. rebuild: the stream was rebuilt. deleted: the stream is gone.

PutStreamResult.description: The answer to a stream PUT.

stream.description: The document as stored, redacted like every response.

applied.description: What the edit did; see Outcome.applied.

ApplyResult.description: What a whole-config write or a reload did.

streams.description: One outcome per stream of the old and the new config, by name.

restart_required.description: The server keys that differ from the running ones and need a restart; empty when none.

etag.description: The ETag of the config now in force.

ConfigStatus.description: The state of the config in force and of the file.

etag.description: The ETag of the config in force.

loaded_at.description: When the config in force was loaded, reloaded or written.

stale.description: The file on disk differs: a reload is pending, and API writes are refused until then.

load_errors.description: The entries the start skipped, until an edit or a reload is applied, and the streams that cannot run and are left stopped, each with the reason of the last edit or reload, which tried it again.

last_reload_at.description: When the last reload was tried.

last_reload_error.description: Why the last reload failed; absent when it did not.

restart_required.description: The server keys that differ from the running ones.

certificate.description: The certificate of the TLS listeners, read at the time of the request; absent without server.tls.

CertStatus.description: The certificate pair in force. Its files are read again every 30 s when they changed, and at every reload; the paths themselves need a restart.

not_after.description: When the leaf in force expires.

names.description: The leaf's subject alternative names: DNS names and IP addresses.

loaded_at.description: When the leaf in force was first read.

last_error.description: Why the latest read of the pair failed; the certificate in force is the one before it. Absent when it did not fail.

Asset.description: One asset: a watermark image or a font in server.assets_dir.

kind.description: What the asset is, by its name.

type.description: The media type, by the content: image/png, image/jpeg, font/ttf or font/otf.

etag.description: The entity tag: a hash of the bytes, the same value as the ETag header.

used_by.description: The streams whose spec names the asset, sorted; [] when none.

AssetPut.description: The answer to an asset upload: the asset, and what each stream that names it did with the new bytes.

kind.description: What the asset is, by its name.

type.description: The media type, by the content: image/png, image/jpeg, font/ttf or font/otf.

etag.description: The entity tag: a hash of the bytes, the same value as the ETag header.

used_by.description: The streams whose spec names the asset, sorted; [] when none.

refreshed.description: One per stream with a supervisor that names the asset; [] when none.

ok.description: The transcoder took the new bytes; the child may not have drawn them yet.

error.description: Why it did not; absent when ok. Between two generations, the next build takes the new bytes.

retried.description: The streams left stopped that name the asset (one could not run for a missing or bad asset), tried again; [] when none.

errors.description: Every single error, for the codes that have several: conflict, invalid_config, invalid_spec; for asset_in_use, the names of the streams.
